scope_note: Static support declaration for the LIMA Python MVP as of IP-0026 (Issue #210; parent #57 PR1 static foundation). Levels state only what repository-internal frozen evidence supports at this commit; no baseline execution, repository scanning, or replay is claimed by this matrix (deferred to #57 PR2/PR3). This JSON is the single source of truth; the human-readable rendering lives in docs/LIMA_Implementation_Packet_IP-0026_Baseline_Static_Foundation.md.

Each entry's commit_sha pins the case's vulnerable_commit (analysis-baseline semantics: the baseline is measured with the vulnerability present); every fixed_commit remains in the frozen file and is not co-registered under the same identity.

capabilities.reason: The frozen contract fails closed when one repository family appears under both the external-holdout and calibration roles in a single manifest (DATASET_ROLE_CONFLICT) or when the same normalized identity repeats (DUPLICATE_REPOSITORY). evaluation_data/popular_external_holdout.json (v1) and evaluation_data/popular_external_calibration_v2.json therefore cannot be co-registered alongside the family datasets already in manifest v1, and no alternate co-registration mechanism exists in this slice.
capabilities.boundary: Excluded from manifest v1 by design (see the registration notes for both files). Any co-registration mechanism is a contract-level decision that requires a new packet and must preserve the evaluation_data/README.md rule that a consumed holdout is reclassified, never double-registered.

capabilities.reason: Offline structural and cross-artifact validation of baseline manifests is delivered by the frozen contract lima/baseline_run_spec.py (schema v1 with typed fail-closed error codes for missing fields, invalid containers, fingerprint mismatch, role crossing, duplicate identities, and identity conflicts) and is exercised end-to-end against the on-disk manifest v1 by the frozen acceptance tests, including deep-copy mutation negatives.
capabilities.boundary: Covers static manifest structure and spec-versus-manifest agreement only; loading orchestration, CLI wiring, and any execution are #57 PR2/PR3 scope and are not claimed here.

capabilities.reason: Immutable revision pinning is enforced fail-closed at spec construction: every repository entry must carry a full 40-character lowercase hex commit SHA, while abbreviated SHAs, branch/tag/moving refs, and 40-character uppercase or non-hex values are rejected with the frozen typed codes (ABBREVIATED_COMMIT_SHA_REJECTED, MOVING_REF_REJECTED, INVALID_COMMIT_SHA). The frozen acceptance tests drive these rejections offline from the on-disk manifest values, and all 13 manifest entries carry full lowercase hex SHAs.
capabilities.boundary: Syntax and immutability shape only: the contract cannot verify offline that a SHA exists in a remote repository (network access is out of scope); materialization of pinned revisions happens at #57 PR2/PR3 execution time under the #57 FR-06 needs-decision guard.

capabilities.reason: Dataset identity is pinned as the lowercase SHA-256 of each frozen data file's exact bytes; the frozen acceptance tests recompute all three digests offline from binary reads and assert equality with manifest v1, and spec-versus-manifest fingerprint drift fails closed (DATASET_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH, INVALID_FINGERPRINT).
capabilities.boundary: Binds manifest identity to the frozen file bytes at rest; it does not verify the per-case vulnerable_archive_sha256/fixed_archive_sha256 archive hashes, which remain case metadata consumed at #57 PR2/PR3 execution time.
